top_rules: PSX lives in textures, not geometry or render: unique-UV atlases baked from a 4-8x source, AO multiplied into colour (0.25 + 0.75*AO), no normal maps (PSX_STYLE#1-2).
Seams, panel joints and grooves read as 1-texel dark lines (AO block rule x2.6, max 0.55) (PSX_STYLE#2 step 3; GEN 'van recipe').
Palette: k-means 64 colours per atlas (32 for close-up interiors), own palette per atlas, then ordered Bayer 4x4 dither amplitude 1/24 (PSX_STYLE#2; psxbake.py).

Texel density: buildings/large ~51.3 px/m ('generator shed density', allowed 48-64), small-prop atlases 64 px/m, sign panels 160 px/m, hand tools 255-418 px/m; avoid density jumps between neighbours (PSX_STYLE#3; contracts).
Atlas sizes: building 1024, props/doors/barrier 512, small props/snow/apparition 256; plane-kit cap 512 (contracts; PLANE_WINTERKIT).
Unity import: Point filter, uncompressed colour, Clamp, sRGB on, aniso 0; mipmaps disputed (see contradictions) (KitBuilder.cs; PSX_STYLE#4).
Materials: URP Lit, smoothness 0, metallic 0, specular highlights off, env reflections off, Cull Back, white base colour + atlas; materials named M_<Pack>_<Atlas> (KitBuilder.cs Lit()).
Tone: cold muted world, bluish-grey snow, dark slate fog; bright pure colour only for signals, lights and signs (PSX_STYLE#5; FOREST_ASSEMBLY#В.1).

Wear like the generator shed: dust/needles on top, dirt in corners, chips to primer on edges, streaks, rust at fasteners, splashes/moss at the ground; fade to chalk on top/south/west, green bloom north (contracts).
Text: own pixel font (pxfont / 5x7 & 3x5), on texel grid, no AA, drawn after palette, no dither on letters, separate panel atlas with emission map; letters >= 5-7 texels (PSX_STYLE#7; contracts).
Sign language: German first, English below on outdoor plates; equipment labels/stencils in English; goods/boxes German (contracts) - Russian appears only as exceptions.

Lamps = 4 parts: Lamp_ body, Lens_ (lit material + _Off twin, emission 2-6), Glow_ additive halo card, LIGHT_ empty; all start off, halos no shadows; colour by temperature (sodium 1900-2100 K, incandescent 2700-3000, halogen 3200-3400, fluorescent 6000-6500 + green) (contracts; LIGHTING#2).

Axes/units: metres, Blender Z-up; Blender (x,y,z) -> Unity (-x, z, -y), angles flip sign, model front -Y -> prefab +Z; FBX 7400, UnitScaleFactor 100; forward axis differs between static packs and the skinned figure (contracts).

Naming: IX_<Name>_<id> moving parts, COL_ box colliders (hidden), LIGHT_/Lens_/Glow_ lamps, Hand_/Spot_/Slot_/Audio_/VFX_/Knock_ points, Kit_ for snow_kit parts, _Off/_b/_Broken variants; rebuilt models keep update-3 names, origins, sizes (contracts).

Each pack delivers FBX + PSX atlases (*_A_px/_E_px or BaseColor/Emission) + <pack>_contract.json (items, parts, lights, sockets, colliders) + lights json + render sheets A-E + src/ Blender scripts (README_SRC); budgets are small: hand props/items ~100-1500 tris (median of all rows ~370), carried parts/fixtures 1-2k, whole packs 5-32k, far landmarks 72k for 13 prefabs, main base 120k (contracts; see budgets).
